mapper.select: select (case when job = 1 then '班主任' when job = 2 then '讲师' when job = 3 then '学工主管' when job = 4 then '教研主管' when job = 5 then '咨询师' end) pos, count(*) num from emp group by job order by num;
select (if (gender = 1, '男性员工', '女性员工')) name, count(*) value from emp group by gender;

select ( case when degree = 1 then '初中' when degree = 2 then '高中' when degree = 3 then '大专' when degree = 4 then '本科' when degree = 5 then '硕士' when degree = 6 then '博士' end ) name, count(*) value from student group by degree;
